basic_info.description: Wow...that was quick. In Contract.  Completely rebuilt 2-bed 1-bath full-floor 867 sqft flat with radiant in-floor heat, washer dryer in-unit, lots of closet and cabinet space, full size gas range, refrigerator, and dishwasher. 400+ sqft common roof deck. Bike parking. Stunning full renovation, seven of eight units sold, this is the last one in the complex, (two four unit properties) don't miss the last one, the others sold quickly. Low HOA $350/mo,  secure leased parking seven doors away on a month-to-month lease
